title: Card Fees: Pass Them On, or Absorb Them?

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.say: Wait. What's this extra fee on my check?
Say lunch is twelve dollars. A three percent card fee adds thirty-six cents. Tiny money. But the surprise weighs more than the cents.
And card fees come with rules. Never on debit cards. Visa caps them at three percent. And a few states ban them altogether.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: You can add a card fee to any check
props.fact: Never on debit, Visa caps it at 3%, some states ban it

scenes.say: The easy way: build card costs into your menu prices. If you do add a fee, put a sign at the door. And never charge it on debit.

props.title: Pass it on, kindly
steps: Fee? Put a sign at the door
